title: How an Adtech Leader Doubled Creative Output Without Increasing Cost During Peak Spend Periods
challenge: During peak spend periods, our growing adtech client faced mounting operational friction that put campaign launch timelines at risk. High creative volumes strained existing QA processes, creating bottlenecks that delayed launches and increased pressure on margins, especially during critical quarters when speed-to-market directly impacted business performance.
To address these bottlenecks, Alloyed built a custom AI tool that serves as an automated, quality-assurance (QA) first pass for HTML ad units.

Before the tool, our senior QA developers were tied up in manual QA work rather than pursuing higher-value innovation and optimization of client workflows. These Alloyed team members had to manually audit every line of code and variables in dynamic creative (DCO) units.

This tedious process inevitably led to delayed QA cycles and pushed error detection to the final stage of production. These late-identified errors, such as broken click tags or unminified files, increased the risk of missed launch dates and extended turnaround times.
solution: The Alloyed-designed AI tool automatically flags and resolves technical non-compliance, including spelling errors, missing alt text, and bloated JS libraries. For this client, the tool enabled the team to move from manual, reactive troubleshooting to an automated, proactive validation model, resulting in:
Faster approval cycles for every asset sent to the ad server
Fewer resubmissions
Significantly lower rejection rates

Furthermore, the tool provides the client with more rapid, scalable quality assurance across high volumes of ad units while ensuring the code is fully commented and optimized. It generates a detailed QA report, extracts variables from manifest files, and provides updated versions of any modified assets (commented and minified). The goal of building this tool was to:
Catch issues early
Ensure delivery-ready, high-performance creative files
Streamline ad unit validation
results: With this innovative solution on their side, the Alloyed Team maintains 100% SLA compliance during peak volume periods, such as Q4, without the need for additional, temporary staffing.

The time required to generate a comprehensive 40+ point QA report and verify copy and variables from manifest files was reduced by approximately 60% to 75%, compared to previous manual processing. As a result, campaigns launched faster, throughput capacity increased, and per-creative costs decreased.

By identifying spec-level errors—issues that may not break the ad but still cause rejections at the ad server level—earlier in the production cycle, the client experienced a drastic reduction in revisions and "dead-on-arrival" creative submissions.

Most notably, our custom-built tool empowers the Alloyed Team to scale creative output by over two times without a corresponding increase in cost, creating operating leverage that protects margins and enables profitable growth during peak demand periods.

title: Automating Quality Control with QA Outsourcing Auditor Tool
challenge: This financial service organization's manual Quality Control (QC) process was heavily dependent on Excel spreadsheets. QC auditors relied on spreadsheets to randomly select inquiries, record audit results, generate reports, and update audited information. This approach was:
Difficult to scale as inquiry volumes grew into the millions
Error-prone, with high risk of inconsistencies
Fragmented, with data scattered across multiple files
Time-consuming and resource-intensive
The client's primary goals were clear: faster access to quality insights, improved data accuracy, process automation, and scalability.
solution: Alloyed partnered with the client to design and develop a centralized web-based QA Auditor Tool that fully automated the QC workflow. Key design features included:
Automation of inquiry assignment: Randomized distribution of inquiries to QC auditors without manual intervention
Instant reporting: Automated generation of quality reports accessible in seconds by administrators
Streamlined workflows: Searching, reviewing, and updating audited inquiries consolidated into a single interface, eliminating fragmented spreadsheet tasks
Structured data management: Secure storage of millions of audit records in a centralized relational database

The QA Auditor Tool was built using a modern technology stack: AWS S3 for secure, scalable storage of audit artifacts; CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery for responsive, user-friendly interfaces; Laravel (PHP Framework) for rapid, scalable web application development; and MariaDB for structured, high-volume data storage.

Alloyed enhanced the solution further by automating daily inquiry uploads via API integration, expanding governance features to improve audit traceability and compliance, and implementing scheduled Cron jobs to run QC checks at designated intervals, ensuring consistent background monitoring of developer outputs without manual oversight.
results: The QA Auditor Tool delivered substantial benefits:
Accuracy and Consistency: Elimination of spreadsheet-related errors and improved reliability of audit data
Continuous Evolution: Since its launch in 2020, the platform has been supported with ongoing maintenance and enhancements to align with the client's evolving operational needs
Efficiency Gains: Significant reduction in manual effort and time spent on QC tasks

title: Global Broadcaster Scales Ad Ops With Major Cost Savings
challenge: Even the biggest names in broadcasting aren't immune to cost pressure. With 46,000 employees worldwide, this media leader had to find a way to do more with less. Budgets were shrinking. Headcount was under the microscope. The SVP of Sales Operations knew they couldn't afford to keep running with fragmented processes and manually intensive ad operations workflows.

The mission was clear: cut costs, streamline operations, and scale smarter, all while ensuring campaigns continued to run flawlessly across digital and linear platforms. The question was how to make it happen without sacrificing accuracy, speed, or client trust.
Bespoke outsourcing, done the right way, became the answer.
solution: We came in as the strategic partner who could help the client evolve roles rather than eliminate them. Internal entry-level employees were promoted into higher-value, more strategic work, while Alloyed Professionals seamlessly backfilled tasks related to trafficking, QA, and reporting.

The partnership started small, with just a three-person digital team, but it didn't stay that way for long. As Alloyed quickly proved its value, the team grew incrementally. By December 2019, the client launched a dedicated Alloyed Linear Team. By 2021, the relationship expanded again, with Alloyed Professionals embedded across five additional business units.

What made the difference wasn't just cost savings, though. It was performance. The Alloyed Team mastered new and complex tasks with impressive speed and accuracy, assuming more responsibility without missing a beat. Our contributions were so effective that word spread internally, and soon, we weren't just filling gaps. We were helping raise the bar.

Because Alloyed operates as a true extension of the client's team, they can do things internal staff can't, such as rapidly scaling up during global events like the Olympics or NBA season, when ad volumes spike and flawless execution is non-negotiable.
results: The results speak for the trust this broadcasting powerhouse has in us.
Flexibility: Alloyed gives the client the agility to scale resources up or down for major events, adding capacity exactly when and where it's needed.

Productivity: The client describes the Alloyed Team's productivity as "on par with onshore executives." With near-perfect accuracy, the team went from working with eight national advertisers to 32, quadrupling output without adding internal headcount.

Trainability: Alloyed not only picks up new tasks quickly, but we've also trained the client's own internal staff on unfamiliar processes, turning what started as tactical support into lasting organizational value.

Over the course of five to six years, we have evolved from a small support team to a critical partner deeply integrated into the client's operating model, to the extent that each Vice President has a directive to shift a percentage of their team's work to Alloyed. It's become a major KPI and directly contributes to their promotion strategy. Using the Alloyed Team to offset workload burdens is more than a nice-to-have. It's a critical support system.

What began as a cost-cutting exercise has evolved into a true strategic partnership, one that delivers consistency, scale, and measurable daily impact for one of the world's largest broadcasting companies.
